description: Create a reviewed brief with required brand_id, source_topic_id when starting from a saved topic, and pillar_id when available. The API approves this supplied brief, making it ready for item generation. Optional facts (at most 20, at most 5 must_use) are user-supplied claims the article cites; they need the v2 article pipeline (409 article_pipeline_not_v2 otherwise) and a refused fact is a 422 with nothing saved.

body.description:
Developer-authored brief spec (request).

Supply an explicit owned ``brand_id``. ``status`` is server-set. ``outline``
is an ordered list of H2 titles; supply plain strings, not Markdown.

attached_document_ids.description: Document library IDs pinned to this brief for prompt-injection (AD-0075).
attached_document_ids.title: Attached Document Ids

example_urls.description: Inspiration-only reference URLs. Never used as source-verification input.
example_urls.title: Example Urls

facts.description: Facts the article cites as supplied claims. Requires the v2 article pipeline (409 article_pipeline_not_v2 otherwise).

items.description:
A fact you supply for the article to cite (request).

One line of plain text, at most 200 characters, with no Markdown, HTML,
links or ``[[``/``]]``. ``source_url`` is optional: its page is fetched
at generation and the fact is cited to it only when the page states every
figure and name in the fact; otherwise the fact is used without a link
(a regulated workspace leaves it out). A ``source_url`` the brand source
policy or the workspace's blocked hosts refuse is a 422
(``user_fact_source_url_ineligible``), and workspaces with
regulated-content settings must supply one (422
``user_fact_source_url_required``). Generation applies these rules again
and leaves out a fact that no longer meets them. At most 20 facts, at
most 5 with ``priority=must_use``.
items.title: PublicBriefFactInput

facts.title: Facts

outline.description: Ordered H2 titles. Mapped to structured brief sections.
outline.title: Outline

source_urls.description: Reference URLs threaded into generation as citable source material.
source_urls.title: Source Urls

body.title: PublicBriefCreate

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation key. Reuse for the same request after a dropped response; use a new key for a new intended operation.
